title: A strict Toledo bound for cocompact complex-hyperbolic lattices of dimension at least two in simple tube-type Hermitian targets with simply connected complexification
source_title: Maximal representations of cocompact complex hyperbolic lattices, a uniform approach
author: Pierre-Emmanuel Chaput; Julien Maubon
difficulty_reason: Uniform cominuscule root calculations build a graded nilpotent Higgs submodule with arithmetic-progression slopes. Its saturated leafwise Higgs sheaf yields a rank-sensitive foliated Milnor–Wood bound, while full-rank Higgs iteration and semistability of symmetric cotangent powers give the stronger tube-type estimate.
